lead: Private conversation, end-to-end encrypted on each device: the server only delivers packets to unnamed boxes, does not know who talks to whom, and not even the Alumia team can read it. To be sure no one is in the middle, compare the safety code.
soMembros: Private messages are only for people who have joined Alumia (18 or older).

ativar.titulo: Turn on messages on this device
ativar.texto: We will create your chat keys here, in the browser. They do not leave this device, unless you link another device by QR code or create an encrypted backup (in the chat settings).
ativar.outroTitulo: Your chat is already active on another device
ativar.outroTexto: To use the chat here too, link this device by QR code (on the device that already has the chat: chat settings, Devices) or restore your backup. Your conversations stay on both.
ativar.outroBotao: Start from scratch on this device
ativar.outroTinha: Warning: this device already had your chat key, but the server now shows a different one. If you turned on messages on another device, that is why. If it was not you, someone may have got into your account: change your password before going on.
ativar.outroRisco: Starting from scratch creates a NEW identity for your chat. People you talk to get a notice that your identity changed, verified conversations lose their mark and you need to compare the code again. What was written before does not open on this device.
ativar.outroEntendi: I no longer have the other device or the backup: I understand the risk and want to start from scratch here
ativar.apagadoTexto: The chat isn't active on this device and its key is no longer here. To chat here, create a new key.
ativar.doZeroTitulo: Without the other device and without the backup

nova.fechada: You cannot open a conversation with this person.

lista.vazio: No conversations yet. Start one with the person's @ (in the field above) or from their profile.
lista.pedidoEnviado: Request sent. Once the person accepts, you can both write.
lista.conversaApagada: You deleted the conversation with this person here. It comes back to the list when a new message arrives.
lista.recusarExplica: Declining deletes the request, and the person cannot ask again for 30 days. They are not told.

conversa.semChave: Cannot be opened on this device (written before a device change).
conversa.semChaveDoOutro: {nome} has not turned on the new messages yet. The conversation opens once they do.
conversa.vazio: No messages. Reminder: never send an address, ID or password, not even here.
conversa.autoriaInvalida: This message's signature does not match.
conversa.mudou: {nome}'s security key changed. It may be a new device, or someone trying to pass as them. Confirm through another channel before going on.
conversa.apagarMensagemConfirma: Delete this message? It leaves this device and the other person's device receives a request to delete it. If they already read it, they may have noted or photographed it.
conversa.bloqueada: Conversation closed: there is a block between you.
conversa.faltam: A message may be missing here: deleted by the writer, expired or held back on the way.
conversa.repetida: Repeated message: this device had already received this same message. It is not shown again.
conversa.duvidosa: This device cannot check whether this message is a repeat (it uses a key that has already closed here). Be wary if it does not make sense now.
conversa.foraDeOrdem: Out of order: the server time does not match the order in which the message was written.
conversa.semConfirmar: When the other person wrote their last message, they had not received this one yet.
conversa.mudouVerificada: {nome}'s safety key changed, and this conversation was verified. The verified mark was removed. It may be a new device, or someone trying to pass as this person. Nothing is sent until you compare the code again.
conversa.grupoPedido: Ask {nome}, in person or through a channel where you recognise each other, for the six groups their screen shows as “your groups” (in Options, under the security code). “Groups so-and-so of the whole code” does not count. Type the six groups:
conversa.grupoErrado: It does not match. Do not go on: someone may be in the middle. Talk to the person through another channel.
conversa.apagarParaMimConfirma: Delete this message from this device only? The other person keeps their copy, and so do your other devices.
conversa.naFila: queued: goes out when {nome} confirms the conversation
conversa.filaAviso: You can write: the device of {nome} has not confirmed the conversation yet. The message is kept here and goes out by itself once it does.
conversa.pedidoSemResposta: {nome} has not accepted the conversation request yet. Once they do, you can write.
conversa.ritmo: Messages leave within 30 seconds and arrive within 1 minute: the device checks at fixed times, so the server does not learn when you talk.

acoes.prazoExplica: Applies to new messages. What was already written keeps its previous time limit.
acoes.codigoExplica: Compare these numbers with the other person, in person or through a channel where you recognize each other. If they match, nobody is in the middle.
acoes.meusGrupos: Your six groups (they come only from your key). If someone needs to compare with you again, read out these:
acoes.bloquearConfirma: Block this person? They will no longer be able to reach you, here or on Alumia.
acoes.apagarConfirma: Remove this conversation from your list? It disappears for you. The other person keeps the messages until their time limit ends.
acoes.qrRotulo: Safety code as a QR, for the other person to scan with the camera
acoes.qrAponte: Point at the QR on the other person's screen. The camera image does not leave this device.
acoes.qrSemCamera: Could not open the camera. Compare the numbers.
acoes.qrConfere: The codes match: conversation verified on this device.
acoes.qrNaoConfere: The codes do NOT match. Do not mark as verified: someone may be in the middle.
acoes.qrOutro: This QR is not an Alumia safety code.
acoes.negavel: Messages carry no signature. Only the two of you have the key to this conversation: the receiver knows it came from the other person, but no message works as proof, to anyone else, of who wrote it.

denuncia.explica: Tick the messages moderation will read. They are decrypted here, on your device, and only they are sent: moderation never has the conversation key. Alumia does not tell the other person who reported, but in a one-to-one conversation they may guess.
denuncia.feito: Report received. Reference {protocolo}. Follow it in My reports.
denuncia.emergencia: In danger right now? In Brazil, call 190. Child or teenager at risk: dial 100.
denuncia.aberto: Warning: the messages you tick leave the encryption and go in plain text to the moderation team. The rest of the conversation stays encrypted.

ajustes.pedidos: Anyone on Alumia (people I don't follow back send a request)
ajustes.apagarTudoExplica: Removes all conversations from your list, on all your devices, and deletes their boxes on the server. The other person in each conversation keeps the messages until they expire. Your account stays. LGPD, art. 18, VI.
ajustes.apagarTudoConfirma: Remove ALL conversations from your list and delete your messaging key? This cannot be undone.
ajustes.sairRapido: The Quick exit button deletes the chat keys, the conversations stored here and the sessions from this device, and signs you out. Afterwards, to use the chat here again, link this device by QR code from another device of yours or restore your backup.
ajustes.coberturaExplica: This device sends fake packets the same size as messages, at random times, and each of your messages goes out in place of one of them: whoever watches the network cannot tell when you really talk. With the chat open, about one packet every 8 seconds; in the background and with the battery below 20%, far fewer. Uses up to 5 MB a day. That is why a message may take up to about 30 seconds to go out.
ajustes.viaDireta: Now: straight to the Institute's server. It sees the internet address (IP) of each request, but not whose box it is.
ajustes.viaTor: Now: through Tor. The server does not see your internet address; someone able to watch the whole network can still compare times.
ajustes.viaMixnet: Now: through the mixnet. Each packet goes through three nodes that hold it for a random time and mix it with packets from people all over the world: neither the server nor someone watching the whole network can link your sending to the other person's fetching.
ajustes.modoRapidoExplica: In fast mode messages arrive sooner, but someone able to watch the whole network (a government, for example) can link, by timing, the moment you send to the moment the other person fetches. Use it only if the delay gets in the way.
ajustes.mixnetDesligada: The mixnet is ready but not yet turned on in this version: your choice applies once it is. To hide your internet address today, open Alumia through the .onion address in Tor Browser.

erros.dm_fechada: You cannot message this person right now.
erros.dm_sem_chave: This person has not turned on the new messages yet. The conversation opens once they do.
erros.versao_desatualizada: The conversation key changed. Try again.
erros.muitos_pedidos: Easy: too many messages in a row. Try again in a moment.
erros.consentimento: Private messages are only for people who have joined Alumia (18 or older).
erros.sem_indexeddb: This browser does not keep the key (private mode?). Messages work only while the tab stays open.
erros.dm_exige_comparar: Compare the safety code again before sending.
erros.dm_aguardando: The other person hasn't opened this conversation on their device yet. Once they do, you can write.
erros.historico_travado: The history is locked. Enter the lock password to open it.
erros.dm_fora_do_registro: The key doesn't match the public log: nothing was sent.
erros.kt_quebrado: Warning: the public key log doesn't add up (someone changed its past). Nothing is sent. Tell the coordination.
erros.muitos_bloqueios: Too many blocks in a short time. Wait an hour.
erros.cedo_para_desbloquear: You can only unblock 3 hours after blocking.
erros.dm_identidade_mudou: This person's identity changed. Nothing was sent: check with them before continuing.
erros.dm_chave_estranha: This person's request key does not match their identity. Nothing was sent.
erros.sem_codinome: Set your @ before using the chat.
erros.frase_curta: Use a passphrase of 12 letters or more.
erros.lista_ocupada: Another device of yours is saving right now. Try again.
erros.sem_servico: The new chat is not turned on in this environment yet.
erros.motor_trocado: The chat key of this device is gone (did the browser clear the site data?). Link this device again with the QR from another of your devices, or restore the backup.

selado.verUmaVezExplica: The other person sees it once and it disappears from their device; no copy is kept, not even by you. This does not prevent a photo or screenshot.
selado.aguardando: The other person has not accepted the request yet, or none of their devices has opened this conversation yet. As soon as one does, you can write.
selado.travado: The history on this device is locked.
selado.travarExplica: Conversation history stays only on this device, encrypted. With the lock, it only opens with your password (which is not stored anywhere). If you forget the password, the history can no longer be opened, not even with help from the team.
selado.senhaCurta: Use a password of 8 characters or more.
selado.trancadoAgora: The history was closed in this tab.

registro.nao_confere: Warning: the key the server shows for this person is not the one in the public log. Don't write anything sensitive and compare the safety code with them through another channel.
registro.meu: Warning: the public log says YOUR chat key is a different one. If you didn't activate the chat on another device, someone may have accessed your account: change your password.
registro.quebrado: Warning: the public key log doesn't add up (someone changed its past). Nothing is sent. Tell the coordination.
registro.carimbo: Public log checked up to {carimbo}. If the other person sees the same number with a different ending, tell the coordination.

voz.explica: End-to-end encrypted voice, only among group members (up to 8 people). Audio goes through a relay server that can't listen, and no one in the room sees the network address of anyone in it.

erros.voz_desligada: Voice hasn't been turned on on the server yet.
erros.voz_sem_retransmissao: Without the relay server, the room doesn't open (your network address would show to the others).
erros.voz_sem_canal: Couldn't open the room right now. Try again.
erros.sem_chave: This device doesn't have the group key yet.
erros.nao_encontrado: Only group members can join the room.

voz.pelOnion: Over Tor, the voice room stays closed: voice doesn't go through Tor, and the relay server would see your network address. Use text.

organizar.soAqui: Organize (only on this device; the other person never knows):

aparelhos.explica: Each device has its own keys; each message is encrypted for each trusted device. The server never sees the keys or the list of your conversations.
aparelhos.ligarOutroExplica: On the new device, sign in, open Conversations and tap "Show QR code". Then scan the QR code here (or paste its text).
aparelhos.ligarRisco: Risk: whoever scans with this device a QR code that is NOT on a device of yours gets your chat keys. Only scan the QR code shown on a device of yours, in front of you. People you talk to see the new-device notice.
aparelhos.ligarEntendi: The QR code is on a device of mine, in front of me
aparelhos.lerQr: Scan the QR code with the camera
aparelhos.colar: Or paste the QR code text
aparelhos.enviado: Done: the keys went to the new device, encrypted. It finishes by itself in a few seconds.
aparelhos.outraConta: This QR code is from a device signed in to ANOTHER account. Nothing was sent.
aparelhos.invalido: This QR code is not an Alumia device link, or it is incomplete. Nothing was sent.
aparelhos.ligarEsteExplica: Show the QR code here and scan it with the device that already has your chat (chat settings, Devices). The QR code is valid for 10 minutes.
aparelhos.qrRotulo: QR code to link this device
aparelhos.semCamera: The other device has no camera? Show the text
aparelhos.esperando: Waiting for the other device to scan the QR code…
aparelhos.ligado: Device linked. Your conversations will appear in a moment.
aparelhos.expirou: The QR code expired (10 minutes). Show a new one.
aparelhos.copiaExplica: Optional. The backup keeps your account keys and the list of conversations, encrypted HERE before leaving. The server only stores the encrypted file and cannot open it. It does not carry the sessions: when restoring, the device is new and conversations are set up again.
aparelhos.copiaRiscos: Risks: whoever has the 24 words (or the passphrase) and gets into your account opens the backup. If you lose the words or the passphrase, the backup no longer opens, not even with help from the team. A short passphrase is easier to guess than the 24 words.
aparelhos.palavrasExplica: 24 random words (safer): write them on paper
aparelhos.fraseExplica: A passphrase of my own (at least 12 letters)
aparelhos.copiaExiste: There is a stored backup, locked with {modo}.
aparelhos.anote: Write down the 24 words, in order, on paper. They will not be shown again and are not stored anywhere.
aparelhos.restaurarExplica: Type the 24 words (or the passphrase) of your backup. This device gets your account keys and the list; conversations are set up again and people you talk to see the new-device notice.
aparelhos.restaurada: Backup restored. Your conversations will appear in a moment.
aparelhos.errada: It did not open: the words or the passphrase do not match.
aparelhos.semCopia: There is no stored backup for this account.

troca.aviso: On {data} the Alumia chat changes its encryption. Beta conversations and groups will be deleted that day, on the server and on this device. If you want to keep something, copy it before then.
troca.depois: Beta conversations were deleted on {data}, as announced.
troca.depoisSemData: Beta conversations were deleted from this device, as announced.
